meta.title: Cycle
meta.description: In her heart, the only one that cannot be let down is delicious chocolate.

units.rawText: Helios Sector, Reactor No. 3.
units.displayText: Helios Sector, Reactor No. 3.

spans.text: Helios Sector, Reactor No. 3.

units.rawText: Log Entry: 5025th collapse observation. Outcome: poor.
units.displayText: Log Entry: 5025th collapse observation. Outcome: poor.

spans.text: Log Entry: 5025th collapse observation. Outcome: poor.

units.rawText: The energy source remains inert even after stimulation. Particle aggregate observations are... (mechanical hiccups)
units.displayText: The energy source remains inert even after stimulation. Particle aggregate observations are... (mechanical hiccups)

spans.text: The energy source remains inert even after stimulation. Particle aggregate observations are... (mechanical hiccups)

units.rawText: Hello.
units.displayText: Hello.

spans.text: Hello.

units.rawText: The agent looks in the direction where the voice came from, and sees a petite girl standing beside him.
units.displayText: The agent looks in the direction where the voice came from, and sees a petite girl standing beside him.

spans.text: The agent looks in the direction where the voice came from, and sees a petite girl standing beside him.

units.rawText: To the agent, her status is quite obvious — she is a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: To the agent, her status is quite obvious — she is a Sanctifier.

spans.text: To the agent, her status is quite obvious — she is a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: You're off work for now, right?
units.displayText: You're off work for now, right?

spans.text: You're off work for now, right?

units.rawText: Ah, yes. May I know what you want?
units.displayText: Ah, yes. May I know what you want?

spans.text: Ah, yes. May I know what you want?

units.rawText: I haven't violated any statutes, have I? I'm not an Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: I haven't violated any statutes, have I? I'm not an Irregular Agent.

spans.text: I haven't violated any statutes, have I? I'm not an Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: Of course not. You're cute and obedient. I've been observing you for some time now.
units.displayText: Of course not. You're cute and obedient. I've been observing you for some time now.

spans.text: Of course not. You're cute and obedient. I've been observing you for some time now.

units.rawText: Observing me for...some time now?
units.displayText: Observing me for...some time now?

spans.text: Observing me for...some time now?

units.rawText: Of course. Cute kids ought to be rewarded, so~
units.displayText: Of course. Cute kids ought to be rewarded, so~

spans.text: Of course. Cute kids ought to be rewarded, so~

units.rawText: How could I not answer any questions you have?
units.displayText: How could I not answer any questions you have?

spans.text: How could I not answer any questions you have?

units.rawText: Go to these coordinates and you'll find the reason.
units.displayText: Go to these coordinates and you'll find the reason.

spans.text: Go to these coordinates and you'll find the reason.

units.rawText: The petite Sanctifier places a silver icon in the agent's hand, then turns and leaves.
units.displayText: The petite Sanctifier places a silver icon in the agent's hand, then turns and leaves.

spans.text: The petite Sanctifier places a silver icon in the agent's hand, then turns and leaves.

units.rawText: At Choco's Chocolaterie.
units.displayText: At Choco's Chocolaterie.

spans.text: At Choco's Chocolaterie.

units.rawText: Welcome to the Chocolaterie, do you need anything?
units.displayText: Welcome to the Chocolaterie, do you need anything?

spans.text: Welcome to the Chocolaterie, do you need anything?

units.rawText: Hello, Choco.
units.displayText: Hello, Choco.

spans.text: Hello, Choco.

units.rawText: You said the same thing this time too. How interesting.
units.displayText: You said the same thing this time too. How interesting.

spans.text: You said the same thing this time too. How interesting.

units.rawText: Huh? How did you know Choco's name?
units.displayText: Huh? How did you know Choco's name?

spans.text: Huh? How did you know Choco's name?

units.rawText: And what did you mean by "this time"...
units.displayText: And what did you mean by "this time"...

spans.text: And what did you mean by "this time"...

units.rawText: Hmm~ let me think.
units.displayText: Hmm~ let me think.

spans.text: Hmm~ let me think.

units.rawText: That's because your name is written on the signboard over here. It's obvious.
units.displayText: That's because your name is written on the signboard over here. It's obvious.

spans.text: That's because your name is written on the signboard over here. It's obvious.

units.rawText: Oh yes! Choco was careless. And what would you like?
units.displayText: Oh yes! Choco was careless. And what would you like?

spans.text: Oh yes! Choco was careless. And what would you like?

units.rawText: One packet of milk chocolate wafers, please and thank you~
units.displayText: One packet of milk chocolate wafers, please and thank you~

spans.text: One packet of milk chocolate wafers, please and thank you~

units.rawText: Choco nods and bends down to take out the package from behind the counter.
units.displayText: Choco nods and bends down to take out the package from behind the counter.

spans.text: Choco nods and bends down to take out the package from behind the counter.

units.rawText: Eucharist supports her head in her hands, looking boredly outside.
units.displayText: Eucharist supports her head in her hands, looking boredly outside.

spans.text: Eucharist supports her head in her hands, looking boredly outside.

units.rawText: That'll be 30 DGC! Come again!
units.displayText: That'll be 30 DGC! Come again!

spans.text: That'll be 30 DGC! Come again!

units.rawText: I will!
units.displayText: I will!

spans.text: I will!

units.rawText: ...Ah, I seem to have forgotten to bring money with me today.
units.displayText: ...Ah, I seem to have forgotten to bring money with me today.

spans.text: ...Ah, I seem to have forgotten to bring money with me today.

units.rawText: Huh? But then you can't take the chocolate away without paying.
units.displayText: Huh? But then you can't take the chocolate away without paying.

spans.text: Huh? But then you can't take the chocolate away without paying.

units.rawText: Aw, it'll be fine, I'll pay the next time I come.
units.displayText: Aw, it'll be fine, I'll pay the next time I come.

spans.text: Aw, it'll be fine, I'll pay the next time I come.

units.rawText: But Choco doesn't have store tabs...
units.displayText: But Choco doesn't have store tabs...

spans.text: But Choco doesn't have store tabs...

units.rawText: RELAX, Don't worry, I'm a Sanctifier, do you think I would default on my debts?
units.displayText: RELAX, Don't worry, I'm a Sanctifier, do you think I would default on my debts?

spans.text: RELAX, Don't worry, I'm a Sanctifier, do you think I would default on my debts?

units.rawText: With that, Eucharist opens the packet of chocolate and takes a bite in front of her.
units.displayText: With that, Eucharist opens the packet of chocolate and takes a bite in front of her.

spans.text: With that, Eucharist opens the packet of chocolate and takes a bite in front of her.

units.rawText: As Choco watches worriedly, Eucharist heads outside.
units.displayText: As Choco watches worriedly, Eucharist heads outside.

spans.text: As Choco watches worriedly, Eucharist heads outside.

units.rawText: Mmm, this is yummy! I'll go get the DGC right...
units.displayText: Mmm, this is yummy! I'll go get the DGC right...

spans.text: Mmm, this is yummy! I'll go get the DGC right...

units.rawText: Look out!
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: Eucharist freezes in her tracks, and an agent suddenly strides out in front of her.
units.displayText: Eucharist freezes in her tracks, and an agent suddenly strides out in front of her.

spans.text: Eucharist freezes in her tracks, and an agent suddenly strides out in front of her.

units.rawText: Ah... That was close, he nearly hit you.
units.displayText: Ah... That was close, he nearly hit you.

spans.text: Ah... That was close, he nearly hit you.

units.rawText: That's strange, usually these researchers aren't in such a rush. Is there something special today?
units.displayText: That's strange, usually these researchers aren't in such a rush. Is there something special today?

spans.text: That's strange, usually these researchers aren't in such a rush. Is there something special today?

units.rawText: Haha... who knows?
units.displayText: Haha... who knows?

spans.text: Haha... who knows?

units.rawText: Sequence No. 0001, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1. Rectification is over, sector reset complete.
units.displayText: Sequence No. 0001, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1. Rectification is over, sector reset complete.

spans.text: Sequence No. 0001, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1. Rectification is over, sector reset complete.

units.rawText: Sequence No. 0075, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1. Sequence No. 5025, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1...
units.displayText: Sequence No. 0075, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1. Sequence No. 5025, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1...

spans.text: Sequence No. 0075, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1. Sequence No. 5025, error cause: Abnormal activity in Reactor No.1...

units.rawText: These logs... They're all from today! Why is all our data being preserved? Isn't anyone screening this?!
units.displayText: These logs... They're all from today! Why is all our data being preserved? Isn't anyone screening this?!

spans.text: These logs... They're all from today! Why is all our data being preserved? Isn't anyone screening this?!

units.rawText: The agent reaches the control center.
units.displayText: The agent reaches the control center.

spans.text: The agent reaches the control center.

units.rawText: Administrator! There are large quantities of unsorted data at these coordinates, I wish to request a troubleshoot.
units.displayText: Administrator! There are large quantities of unsorted data at these coordinates, I wish to request a troubleshoot.

spans.text: Administrator! There are large quantities of unsorted data at these coordinates, I wish to request a troubleshoot.

units.rawText: These coordinates... Thanks for your feedback. I'll troubleshoot it.
units.displayText: These coordinates... Thanks for your feedback. I'll troubleshoot it.

spans.text: These coordinates... Thanks for your feedback. I'll troubleshoot it.

units.rawText: ...After examination, there are no problems with the file data at these coordinates.
units.displayText: ...After examination, there are no problems with the file data at these coordinates.

spans.text: ...After examination, there are no problems with the file data at these coordinates.

units.rawText: But if this redundant data accumulates, it'll bring all our agents to a halt.
units.displayText: But if this redundant data accumulates, it'll bring all our agents to a halt.

spans.text: But if this redundant data accumulates, it'll bring all our agents to a halt.

units.rawText: The report has been handled. Please return to your position.
units.displayText: The report has been handled. Please return to your position.

spans.text: The report has been handled. Please return to your position.

units.rawText: The ground of the control center begins shaking.
units.displayText: The ground of the control center begins shaking.

spans.text: The ground of the control center begins shaking.

units.rawText: At this rate... We'll become nothing more than storage banks for data!
units.displayText: At this rate... We'll become nothing more than storage banks for data!

spans.text: At this rate... We'll become nothing more than storage banks for data!

units.rawText: We were created for the Arche Pyr. It can't be helped even if we become storage banks.
units.displayText: We were created for the Arche Pyr. It can't be helped even if we become storage banks.

spans.text: We were created for the Arche Pyr. It can't be helped even if we become storage banks.

units.rawText: The agent closes its eyes.
units.displayText: The agent closes its eyes.

spans.text: The agent closes its eyes.

units.rawText: Within its computational core, it sees the distant shockwave piercing through the buildings of the sector and approaching the control center.
units.displayText: Within its computational core, it sees the distant shockwave piercing through the buildings of the sector and approaching the control center.

spans.text: Within its computational core, it sees the distant shockwave piercing through the buildings of the sector and approaching the control center.

units.rawText: The blast is coming.
units.displayText: The blast is coming.

spans.text: The blast is coming.

units.rawText: Everything I have done will be reduced to ash in the violent explosion of the reactor pile...
units.displayText: Everything I have done will be reduced to ash in the violent explosion of the reactor pile...

spans.text: Everything I have done will be reduced to ash in the violent explosion of the reactor pile...

units.rawText: Will we succeed before we permanently shut down, Administrator?
units.displayText: Will we succeed before we permanently shut down, Administrator?

spans.text: Will we succeed before we permanently shut down, Administrator?

units.rawText: We...
units.displayText: We...

spans.text: We...

units.rawText: The operands deform under the incoming thermal spike. The roar of the explosion and the white light are reduced to a monotonous noise.
units.displayText: The operands deform under the incoming thermal spike. The roar of the explosion and the white light are reduced to a monotonous noise.

spans.text: The operands deform under the incoming thermal spike. The roar of the explosion and the white light are reduced to a monotonous noise.

units.rawText: Sequence No. 5053, commencing rectification.
units.displayText: Sequence No. 5053, commencing rectification.

spans.text: Sequence No. 5053, commencing rectification.

units.rawText: ...Feedback, excessive redundant data detected. All complex agents will permanently stall within 3 resets.
units.displayText: ...Feedback, excessive redundant data detected. All complex agents will permanently stall within 3 resets.

spans.text: ...Feedback, excessive redundant data detected. All complex agents will permanently stall within 3 resets.

units.rawText: Downgrade complete.
units.displayText: Downgrade complete.

spans.text: Downgrade complete.

units.rawText: At Choco's Chocolaterie.
units.displayText: At Choco's Chocolaterie.

spans.text: At Choco's Chocolaterie.

units.rawText: Welcome to the Chocolaterie, do you need anything?
units.displayText: Welcome to the Chocolaterie, do you need anything?

spans.text: Welcome to the Chocolaterie, do you need anything?

units.rawText: Hello, Choco.
units.displayText: Hello, Choco.

spans.text: Hello, Choco.

units.rawText: You said the same thing this time too... Honestly, it's getting boring now.
units.displayText: You said the same thing this time too... Honestly, it's getting boring now.

spans.text: You said the same thing this time too... Honestly, it's getting boring now.

units.rawText: Huh? How did you know Choco's name?
units.displayText: Huh? How did you know Choco's name?

spans.text: Huh? How did you know Choco's name?

units.rawText: And what did you mean by "this time"...
units.displayText: And what did you mean by "this time"...

spans.text: And what did you mean by "this time"...

units.rawText: Hmm~ let me think.
units.displayText: Hmm~ let me think.

units.rawText: That's because your name is written on the signboard over here. It's obvious.
units.displayText: That's because your name is written on the signboard over here. It's obvious.

spans.text: That's because your name is written on the signboard over here. It's obvious.

units.rawText: Oh yes! Choco was careless. And what would you like, dear customer?
units.displayText: Oh yes! Choco was careless. And what would you like, dear customer?

spans.text: Oh yes! Choco was careless. And what would you like, dear customer?

units.rawText: I'm here to pay my tab. Here, 30 DGC.
units.displayText: I'm here to pay my tab. Here, 30 DGC.

spans.text: I'm here to pay my tab. Here, 30 DGC.

units.rawText: Huh? You're paying your tab? Have you misremembered, perhaps?
units.displayText: Huh? You're paying your tab? Have you misremembered, perhaps?

spans.text: Huh? You're paying your tab? Have you misremembered, perhaps?

units.rawText: Choco doesn't keep tabs, so there's no need to pay them...
units.displayText: Choco doesn't keep tabs, so there's no need to pay them...

spans.text: Choco doesn't keep tabs, so there's no need to pay them...

units.rawText: Oh right, that's true!
units.displayText: Oh right, that's true!

spans.text: Oh right, that's true!

units.rawText: One packet of milk chocolate wafers, please and thank you~
units.displayText: One packet of milk chocolate wafers, please and thank you~

spans.text: One packet of milk chocolate wafers, please and thank you~

units.rawText: Alright, one packet of milk chocolate wafers, here you go!
units.displayText: Alright, one packet of milk chocolate wafers, here you go!

spans.text: Alright, one packet of milk chocolate wafers, here you go!

units.rawText: Hmm... If you made Energy Grass into chocolate and ate it, it might have some special effects.
units.displayText: Hmm... If you made Energy Grass into chocolate and ate it, it might have some special effects.

spans.text: Hmm... If you made Energy Grass into chocolate and ate it, it might have some special effects.

units.rawText: Huh?
units.displayText: Huh?

spans.text: Huh?

units.rawText: Eucharist doesn't reply to Choco. Instead she leaves the chocolaterie with the packet of chocolate.
units.displayText: Eucharist doesn't reply to Choco. Instead she leaves the chocolaterie with the packet of chocolate.

spans.text: Eucharist doesn't reply to Choco. Instead she leaves the chocolaterie with the packet of chocolate.

units.rawText: As she looks at the robot that just ran past her, Eucharist opens the package she's holding.
units.displayText: As she looks at the robot that just ran past her, Eucharist opens the package she's holding.

spans.text: As she looks at the robot that just ran past her, Eucharist opens the package she's holding.

units.rawText: It doesn't seem like enough of a change.
units.displayText: It doesn't seem like enough of a change.

spans.text: It doesn't seem like enough of a change.

units.rawText: Still, doing any more would be boring, and Lord Eosphorus would probably warn me... I should just keep watching!
units.displayText: Still, doing any more would be boring, and Lord Eosphorus would probably warn me... I should just keep watching!

spans.text: Still, doing any more would be boring, and Lord Eosphorus would probably warn me... I should just keep watching!

units.rawText: ...How long will it take for you to move on, Helios Sector?
units.displayText: ...How long will it take for you to move on, Helios Sector?

spans.text: ...How long will it take for you to move on, Helios Sector?

units.displayText: Error. Redundant data detected... Crash risk present.

spans.text: Error. Redundant data detected... Crash risk present.

units.rawText: The agent slaps its own head in mild confusion.
units.displayText: The agent slaps its own head in mild confusion.

spans.text: The agent slaps its own head in mild confusion.

units.rawText: Checking for reason... Check failed.
units.displayText: Checking for reason... Check failed.

spans.text: Checking for reason... Check failed.

units.rawText: We need more detailed data to examine the effects of each element in the agent.
units.displayText: We need more detailed data to examine the effects of each element in the agent.

spans.text: We need more detailed data to examine the effects of each element in the agent.

units.rawText: ...Even if it means we all stall out because of it?
units.displayText: ...Even if it means we all stall out because of it?

units.displayText: Please return to your position and continue your observations...
